meta.name: agenthub
meta.description: Multi-agent collaboration plugin that spawns N parallel subagents competing on the same task via git worktree isolation. Agents work independently, results are evaluated by metric or LLM judge, and the best branch is merged. Use when: user wants multiple approaches tried in parallel — code optimization, content variation, research exploration, or any task that benefits from parallel competition. Requires: a git repo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行运行多个子代理竞争同一任务，自动合并最优结果
copy.tagline_en: Run multiple subagents in parallel on the same task and auto-merge the best result
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want multiple approaches tried in parallel and the best one automatically merged

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以同时启动多个独立 AI 子代理，每个代理在隔离的 git 工作区中并行尝试不同方案完成任务。最后自动评估所有结果，合并最优方案。
howto.when: 当你需要为同一任务尝试多种不同方法时触发，例如代码优化、内容变体、研究探索等。要求当前项目是一个 git 仓库。

say.text: 帮我用三个代理并行优化这段代码的性能。
让五个代理同时写不同的文案版本，然后选出最好的。
say.note: Claude 会并行生成多个文案，评估后合并最优版本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can spawn multiple independent AI subagents that work in parallel on the same task, each in an isolated git worktree. Results are evaluated and the best branch is merged automatically.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want multiple approaches tried in parallel for the same task, such as code optimization, content variation, or research exploration. Requires a git repository.

say_en.text: Use three agents to optimize this code in parallel.
Have five agents write different copy versions and pick the best.
